title: a16z Podcast: An Economics Take on the Sharing Economy

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Love the term or hate it.
reader_summary.overview: Love the term or hate it, the concept and reality of the "sharing economy" (or "gig economy" and so on) is here to stay. And in fact, argues NYU Stern professor and researcher Arun Sundararajan. Because it's a new model for (crowd-based) capitalism -- one where we're increasing the segment of the population that owns the means of production.
